description: Test suite for Kubernetes event rate limiting admission plugin, including various scenarios for token limits, namespace, source+object, and user limits, as well as event attribute inclusion.

methods.name: attributesForRequest
methods.description: Generates admission.Attributes for a given request, including event, kind, namespace, user, and dryRun status.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates a new request object with default accepted status.

methods.name: newEventRequest
methods.description: Creates a new request object for an event kind.

methods.name: newNonEventRequest
methods.description: Creates a new request object for a non-event kind.

methods.name: withNamespace
methods.description: Sets the namespace for the request.

methods.name: withEvent
methods.description: Associates an event object with the request.

methods.name: withDryRun
methods.description: Sets the dryRun flag for the request.

methods.name: withUser
methods.description: Sets the username for the request.

methods.name: blocked
methods.description: Marks the request as blocked (not accepted).

methods.name: withDelay
methods.description: Simulates delay in request processing by advancing the clock.
